note: National spirits any focus tree, event or decision can use. No country starts with these; spirits for real starting situations live in per-country files with sources. Values are gameplay estimates.

spirits.name: Endemic corruption
spirits.description: Bribes and kickbacks are part of everyday dealings with the state.

spirits.name: Anti-corruption campaign
spirits.description: Audits, prosecutions and new oversight bodies take on corruption, at the price of friction inside the state.

spirits.name: Brain drain
spirits.description: Engineers, doctors and scientists leave for better pay abroad.

spirits.name: War economy
spirits.description: Industry and the budget are put on a war footing.

spirits.name: Reconstruction effort
spirits.description: A national programme rebuilds housing, power and transport.

spirits.name: Professional civil service
spirits.description: Officials are hired and promoted on merit.

spirits.name: Digital government
spirits.description: Taxes, permits and records are handled online.

spirits.name: Austerity
spirits.description: Spending cuts to balance the budget.

spirits.name: Economic stimulus
spirits.description: Borrowing to fund public investment.

spirits.name: Balanced budget
spirits.description: The public finances are in order and borrowing is cheap.

spirits.name: Export-led growth
spirits.description: Manufacturing for export markets drives growth.

spirits.name: Sovereign wealth fund
spirits.description: Resource revenue is saved for future generations.

spirits.name: State planning
spirits.description: Investment is directed by state plans.

spirits.name: Open society
spirits.description: Independent courts, a free press and competitive elections.

spirits.name: Mobilised nation
spirits.description: Universal military training and a war economy under a one-party state.

spirits.name: Military rule
spirits.description: Officers run the ministries and the security services.

spirits.name: Religious revival
spirits.description: Faith shapes law, schools and public life.

spirits.name: Armed neutrality
spirits.description: Strong defences and no alliances.

spirits.name: Science drive
spirits.description: Grants and new research universities.

spirits.name: Universal healthcare
spirits.description: Everyone is covered by public health care.
